name: Ring of Spell Turning
description: A silver ring set with a small round mirror.
body:
## What it does

A spell aimed at you alone, and not at an area, has a hard time taking hold of you. If your save against it comes up 20 and the spell is 7th level or lower, it turns back on its caster instead.

advantages.name: Saving throws
advantages.note: against spells that target only you, not an area

features.name: Turning
features.text: On a 20 on that save, a spell of 7th level or lower targets its caster instead, with the caster's slot, save DC, attack bonus and ability.
